notes.title: Berta the Highland Cow!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]The past 2 weeks we've been working on Berta, and we're thrilled to launch her now so that you can enjoy her! You might know Berta from our cute emojis on Discord already. She's an adorable fluffy highland cow who loves strolling through nature. Her ears wiggle and she grunts while running.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/20a6808e0937cd86692cd2a10d0c87d0762dfb04.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/00df2b13908add165de0afec014ffc37deff62fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We know many of you were asking for a way to run faster, which is something that Berta will help you with. And yes, you [b]can pet her[/b] ![/p][p][/p][p]If you're curious about how she came to be: here is how we created her![/p][p][/p][p]We started with a very VERY rough shape using Zbrush.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/08730a3b533264615f4c34ce0f0685e7e0a2899e.png"][/img][/p][p]We then added some smaller details, like ears and the fur.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/f80d4613ce4e516122e7f55d550fbe009d92cd64.png"][/img][/p][p]Then some more details![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/f6ac01ff3d1f51ffa1c98b1953f15e9c49ca2267.png"][/img][/p][p]Then some base colour![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/250f4a6b3e65978ece425eb471c1a90f778ccb16.png"][/img][/p][p]And then some more highlights onto the base colour so that she now looks like this![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/d1e5d3745d8c740170171627d26da613b51463c0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy riding on your very own highland cow! [/p][p]This work has also shown us that we can implement different ways of movement in a relatively short time, so in the future we'll be exploring other ways to move through nature... maybe [b]cough[/b] paddle boarding [b]cough[/b]....Who said that?![/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day![/p][p]Elena & the Yaldi Team[/p]

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/20a6808e0937cd86692cd2a10d0c87d0762dfb04.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for everyone who has purchased our cozy foraging game! We're a small indie studio and this is our first game so your support is helping us a LOT so we're super grateful 🙏🙏🙏🙏[/p][p][/p][p]The last 2 weeks we've been fixing bugs, listening to your suggestions and started implementing a few of them! But of course this is just the start so we wanted to share with you what's next so that you have a better idea of how we're structuring this Early Access.[/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]First things first: Your feedback helps us improve the game![/b][/h3][p]If you want to help us, please fill out this form. There aren't any required questions so you can only fill in those you have answers for. [url="https://forms.gle/Vq32iCQME6QRXBpi6"]https://forms.gle/Vq32iCQME6QRXBpi6[/url] This will help us make better choices and improve the game longterm! :) Of course we will keep checking all the channels but this form is a much easier way to compare player sentiment with.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]So what's next?[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Highland Cow Mount Berta[/h3][p]We started working on a highland cow [b]MOUNT, [/b]called Berta, of which we have posted a tiktok video here:  [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@yaldigames/video/7531023732555402518?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7504658062340769302"]https://www.tiktok.com/@yaldigames/video/7531023732555402518?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7504658062340769302[/url]. (Just FYI we generally post updates on TikTok 3 times per week, so follow us there or join our Discord to see the videos in our social channel.)[/p][p][/p][h3]Summer Season[/h3][p]Out and About is all about foraging and nature, so of course our major updates will revolve around seasons! We are now starting work on the [b]summer season[/b], which will contain new plants and mushrooms, new recipes, a new chapter of the story, 3 more friendship levels for each NPC, and even one new NPC (Kiano). [/p][p][/p][p]But because our programmer is on holiday almost all of October, we expect to ship this update [b]early November[/b]. Until then, we will work on smaller updates (see below).[/p][p][/p][h3]Smaller Updates[/h3][p]Since our programmer is on holiday for a long time, we want to do more art focussed updates while he is gone, such as new plants, recipes, outfits and quests. We're looking for your opinions on what you would like best! Please use the form above to tell us.[/p][p][/p][h3]Autumn Season[/h3][p]After we shipped the summer season update in Nov we will start working on the [b]autumn [/b]season, which will include a lot of shrubs with berries and trees with nuts, plus a wider variety of mushrooms (and of course new recipes, a new story chapter, quests etc!).[/p][p][/p][p]This is as far as we can reveal for now, since [b]any further plans are all based on the feedback you give us in the next months.[/b] I hope you realise that we're here to listen to you and your ideas and that we value them very much![/p][p][/p][p]If we can, we would love to develop this game way beyond the 1.0 launch. We'd love to add DLCs of different regions of the world (think: Japan, Brazil, China, Africa!) and new things to learn, such as bird identification, or insects, or fishing. We'd love to make this the nature game of your (and our) dreams. So I hope we can grow, get more players and then have all those resources we need to make that happen. And your trust and purchase is the first step so thanks for supporting us and leaving a positive review ❤️❤️❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day!! ❤️[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/00df2b13908add165de0afec014ffc37deff62fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 - August 25st, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

[list]
[*] Increased coin value of favours by 20% and increased the maximum items sellable in a single market to 20.
[*] In practice, this should increase player coin income by 15-25% depending on playstyle. More adjustments will come to project costs in future patches as needed.
[*] Several changes and in-game clarifications on how item decay works. For the sake of clarity, here is how it works as of this patch:
[*] Unsorted items in the basket decay at end of each day.
[*] Sorted foraged parts in your inventory decay after completion of the upcoming market event.
[*] A warning now comes up at the start of markets indicating this.
[*] Skipping or cancelling a market will delay item decay.
[*] Crafted items will fully decay on market completion if they had a red indicator on their icon in the inventory prior to the market.
[*] As a consequence of this update, crafted items in existing inventories will have their decay durations reset to full.
[*] Reworked the Tutorial text and changed when the tutorial pops up.
[*] Fast travel has been re-enabled to test a potential fix for infinite loading screens when teleporting to Elder Moor and Portobello Woods.
[*] If you still encounter any issues with fast travel, please let us know!
[*] Favours will only generate for items that you have discovered all parts for and unlocked necessary harvesting tools for. No more impossible favours!
[*] Existing favours in your current day are not affected. These rules only impact newly generated favours.
[*] Updated the "interaction particle" for certain quest objectives and discoverable community projects to be more noticeable.
[*] Added a customization mirror to the community kitchen that allows changing clothes and character appearance.
[*] Added rotation button to the customization menu to rotate the character by 90 degrees.
[*] Swapped the position of the Camera and Calendar apps on the phone. This should make accessing the calendar from the phone easier, as it eliminates the need to navigate to page 2.
[*] Added a fullscreen/windowed toggle box to graphics settings.
[*] When in windowed mode, players can drag the window edge to resize it as needed. If you swap to windowed mode, you might find it is the same size as your display, so it can be tricky to drag the window edges to resize. Try using the Windows hotkey for full-screen toggle (F11) if you have trouble with this. We will provide more detailed resolution settings in a future update.
[*] Item crafting favours will now be completable immediately if you have the required item already crafted.
[*] Note that this does not affect already accepted favours. Only newly generated favours will behave this way.
[/list]

Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Granny's last quest (so far) that was preventing it from being offered at the end of her questline.
[*] Fixed an instance where community projects in Our Porto would have their title partially cut off if pinned.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause several interfaces not to update correctly, even though progress was technically happening. This was most noticeable with friendship levels and quest tracking.
[*] Fixed some community projects not pinning and unpinning correctly relative to their respective quests.
[*] Updated some hints for various quests for objective clarity.
[*] Fixed typos in plant descriptions.
[*] Fixed grammatical error in foraging patch prompt when basket full.
[*] Fixed typo in "Brewing Up Ideas" quest
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 - August 15th, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

- Increased streaming pool size from 1000MB to 2000MB.This is our first attempt to address blurry models for plants during identification, harvesting, and sorting. Please let us know if you continue experiencing this issue, and we will investigate further.
- Moved immersive mode setting from General to Graphics tab.Added left click as option for advancing dialogue.
- Added settings to invert camera X and Y axis.
- Added "skip" option in forest bathing to fix an issue where the player could get locked in forest bathing if an obstacle blocked the path between the player and the bathing spot. The original issue this was made to solve has been resolved, but the skip button will remain for now if people wish to use it.

Fixes

- Fixed an issue preventing players from progressing Annie's Nettle Farm quest.
- Fixed save files affected by the bugged Annie's Nettle Farm quest if players had completed the project before this patch.
- Fixed an issue causing some quest objectives to not update correctly.
- Fixed an issue where the player could trigger Charles' community project discovery dialogue while in photo mode.
- Updated meditation spots to prevent players from getting stuck while walking to their centres.
- Fixed an issue where player movement could break if initiating forest bathing while already on the correct spot.
- Fixed a typo in Barbara's "The Taste of Childhood" quest.
- Fixed typo in Charles' "Dash of Colour" quest
- Fixed an issue where time was incorrectly set to morning on fresh saves.
- Fixed missing community spirit reward for Linda's tier 3 friendship quest.
- Fixed issue where player had jumping enabled indoors when loading a save from the community kitchen, allowing player to escape bounds.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 - August 12th, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes
- Disabled fast travel temporarily to avoid issues with players getting infinite loading screens while we work on a proper fix.
- Added a link to the community discord as well as the most recent patch notes and known issues list to the main menu.
- Swapped the day transition video for an in-game cinematic version for visual quality and stability.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on Annie's Nettle Farm friendship quest if they'd already unlocked the Nettle Farm beforehand.
- Fixed an issue where Quests completed during game load by patch fixes would record the wrong quest completion times.
- Fixed an issue where Quests completed during game load by patch fixes would not show in the quest journal as 'Completed'.
- Fixed blocker allowing player to reach Waveward Beach without completing "Access to Waveward Beach" community project.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would lose their starting items.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would not see storefront items.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would have their characters appear broken (every category displayed as Skin Details and not starting with the default character) in customisation until randomising.
- Fixed a dandelion and coltsfoot patch at Ginkgo's rest that was very difficult to photograph.
- Fixed typos in various quests 
- Fixed several quests where NPCs would teleport away unintentionally
- Adjusted blocking volumes in various areas to prevent outmapping and getting stuck.
- Prevented premature unlocking of the nettle farm project that would break quest progression if completed before the appropriate quest.
Note: save files already affected by this bug will be fixed in an upcoming patch. - 
- Added missing Angel's Wings foraging patches.
- Fixed some grass and landscape issues around Granny's house.

notes.title: The Release Button is Gone. (Literally.)
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]we're heartbroken to say this but [b]we can't release today.[/b] We literally can't press the button. It's gone.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is ready to go, everything was prepared - but since this is our first release ever, we forgot to tick the "Early Access" checkbox on the Steam backend until this morning. And once that is ticked, Steam automatically put our Steam page in review  mode- a normal process on their end but for us it couldn't have come at a worse time. This has caused the release button to [b]disappear[/b], we cannot click it. [/p][p][/p][p]So we can't launch T-T [/p][p][/p][p]We were super stressed about this all morning, we wrote tickets to Steam. But they're on PDT time where it was still the middle of the night. [/p][p][/p][p]We don't know if Steam will accelerate our review, we can't assume anything since they are very busy. Reviews usually take 3-5 days. So we're stuck with just one option: to delay the release until Monday.[/p][p][/p][p]We're so sorry, to all of you who were looking forward to this game launching today. We're extremely sad since we worked so hard to get everything ready for you. Our backers have received overwrite keys so they can already play today, but everyone else will need to wait until the release button shows up again, and we can press it.[/p][p][/p][p]This is all due to our inexperience, we never released a game before and didn't know about the Early Access tickbox and its implications. All I can say is...[/p][p][/p][p]WE'RE SO SOORRRYYYYY T-T [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/b41d83f7ed1a02acb665ce4acce5b171838c1b04.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p][b]
We have some huge news! Out and About is launching into Early Access on Steam on August 7th! 🎉[/b][/p][p]
Thank you for being part of this incredible journey! We started with a dream to create a cozy, nature-loving adventure and now, after years of hard work (and your amazing support!), we’re almost ready to share it with you.[/p][p]
What does the game look like at Early Access?
🍄 Learn to identify 55+ real plants, fungi and seaweeds!
🍳 Cook over 90+ tasty recipes and sell them at the local market!
💖 Build friendships with the neighbours of Portobello, which includes 3 friendship levels and special quests!
🏠 Restore your childhood home and bring life back to the community! We'll have dozens of community projects for you to do![/p][p][/p][p]Altogether we estimate the gameplay time to be 17-25h! 🥳

As you know, we wanted to create something more than "just" a game, a little love letter to nature, filled with real-world knowledge about foraging, cooking, and seasonal living. Every plant and fungus you find in-game is based on real species, with actual identification tips to help you learn as you play.[/p][p]
This Early Access launch is just the beginning. Your feedback is going to be essential as we add even more recipes, plants, and cozy adventures to Portobello. [/p][p][/p][p]Here's an idea what you can expect over the course of Early Access:[/p][list][*][p]a ridable mount[/p][/*][*][p]new seasons[/p][/*][*][p]new plants, minigames and recipes[/p][/*][*][p]new chapters of the story[/p][/*][*][p]new friendship levels and quests[/p][/*][*][p]new features[/p][/*][*][p]and many improvements based on the feedback you and the community give us![/p][/*][/list][p]
Thank you so much for helping us get here. We can’t wait to see you out in the fields (virtually speaking!) on August 7th.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/2737fa18a2fff7f95485b25210ec0fe5c6b94c84.png"][/img]
💚 The Out and About Team[/p]

notes.title: PLAYTEST LIVE NOW!
notes.notes: [h2][b]A Big Day for Our Small Team[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]We’re thrilled to share that [i]Out and About[/i] is featured in [b]Wholesome Direct[/b] and launching its first [b]public playtest[/b] today![/h3][p][/p][p]This game began as a tribute to nature, foraging, community, and climate resilience. The idea was born six years ago, after I went foraging for the very first time. I realized how deeply foraging connects us to the natural world. Learning to identify plants changes the way you see your surroundings. Every familiar leaf becomes a spark of joy. That sense of awe is what grounds us, and heals us. Having experienced this myself, I wanted to create a game that lets you feel that same connection to nature.[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s playtest is a huge milestone. We've been working toward this moment for a long time, and if you've followed our journey, you’ll see just how far the game has come.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re putting this playtest in your hands because we genuinely care about your thoughts. Your feedback has already shaped so much of the game—from the hairstyles and noses you voted for in customization, to the choice to allow the harvesting of poisonous plants, to the recently added immersive mode. So please, tell us what you think: what you liked, what didn’t land, and what you’d love to see more of (using the form below!).[/p][p][/p][p]Most of us are making our very first game. Not just at Yaldi, but ever. That’s also why it took a little longer to get here. But we made it. And we couldn’t have done it without your support - especially from our Kickstarter backers![/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy the playtest and give us [b]feedback[/b] using this form: [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/xXh9YwFubRjrHBEYA"]https://forms.gle/xXh9YwFubRjrHBEYA[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]If you find [b]bugs[/b], you can report them via the game or by using this form: [url="https://wkf.ms/43nnWEs"]https://wkf.ms/43nnWEs[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Also, don't forget to join our [b]Discord[/b] ([url="https://discord.gg/sR7zhJMFsk"]https://discord.gg/sR7zhJMFsk[/url]) to meet your fellow foragers![/p][p][/p][p][b]PS:[/b] We don't know why it shows "Controllers not supported" in the library. The game does support Xbox and Playstation controllers. Just click "View controller settings" and activate Steam Input. Then it works perfectly![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/c012e96fafe88c400d1e48e735dd469f29d7e96a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer Update January
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🌈

I hope you all had a restful festive season and a good start into the new year! 2025 will be our most exciting year so we're really looking forward to it!

As you know, we want to release Out and About into Early Access on PC in Spring! We can't yet tell you when exactly (it's still a secret) 😉 but it won't be too long!

So let's look at some of the things we worked on in January! 

[b]New Music Direction[/b]
We hadn't been able to invest in music in a long time, but last year we finally got to create a few more pieces. However, the direction of the music changed because the game itself had grown and changed. Now, the focus is much more on relaxation and nature. Have a listen to this sample of the forest music and tell us what you think!

[previewyoutube=EYj7ygnm4tQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Sea Shader[/b]
Our artist Niko recently reworked our water shader and blew us away with the result. It's hard to remember our old water now that we have seen this beautiful shader in action. It's almost like our minds forcefully forgot it - we'll have to find some old videos to compare them one day! 🤣

[previewyoutube=N2uCOjpyBy0;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Filler NPCs for a more lively world[/b]
If you played our demo, you know that our beautiful little town feels a bit like a ghost town - but now we created a wide range of characters that we can place in the world to make it feel more lively. Since this is our first game, there is lots to learn about NPC navigation (and performance relating to that), so we'll have to start with the basics. But we're sure that this will already have an enormous effect on the liveliness of the world, so we're very excited to implement them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/e4a63b8bbed6081376fb9574896603a66d6cd185.png[/img]

[b]Barbara's Farm[/b]
Barbara is your foraging teacher, but her family also owned a farm outside town. Now Barbara wants to restore it, and combine traditional farming with Paludiculture (= productive land use of wet and rewetted peatlands). We're excited to integrate this into the game and shed some light on this topic. Here are some concept sketches of the farm and the colored version we chose!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/35e22435db588e455865502fd9e313c0e9461234.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/01859a1c764195e122590ee52a9e991ea2c3e072.png[/img]

As you can see, we went for a combination of Nr 3 and 1. Which number of the concept art would you have chosen?


That's it for this month's update! Take care and have a good week everyone!

Jen & Elena💖

As you know this game is about highlighting community and how we can come together. So of course our little town has a community garden! The community garden will be a place for the NPCs to have their own garden lots and grow their favourite vegetables and fruit, which they will share with you. There will be a long list of community projects for you to rebuild and grow this garden, unlocking more and more as the game progresses.

This is not final and will likely change and adapt in the future as we continue implementing it, but what is certain is that it will be a beautiful place for you to rebuild and bond with characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/0f16386def74b426df505b87882b81b3bba893ff.png[/img]

[b]Join Our Discord![/b]

Have a great day everyone!

notes.title: Coastal Foraging and The Last Few Days of Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello fellow foragers,

As we approach the last few days of the Out and About [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/elenahoge/wholesome-out-and-about]Kickstarter[/url] campaign, I’m excited to share some huge stretch goals with you. Last week you, being the amazing community that you are, unlocked the following stretch goals!

[b][u]Nintendo Switch port[/u][/b] - That’s right, you can literally go out and about while playing Out and About.

[u][b]Coastal Foraging[/b][/u] - There’s only one thing nicer than foraging in the wilderness, and that’s foraging by the sea. This will bring a host of new plants and recipes, which can only be found in coastal regions.

[u][b]More mushrooms and plants[/b][/u] - I know, I didn't think we would have much-room to fit more ingredients into the game (sorry, not sorry). This will increase the amount of recipes you can learn, both in and out of Out and About.

Thank you,

Elena

notes.title: Out and About is Live on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello fellow foragers,

We have some exciting news today, our Kickstarter campaign is now live!

Ever since we started the development of Out and About, we wanted the community to be heavily involved with its direction and design. From the way you customise your character to recipes you can forage for, we always wanted you to be part of the process. Your support over the past 18 months has been amazing, and we would appreciate any support you could now lend to the Kickstarter campaign. From backing the project, or sharing it on social media, every interaction is really appreciated, we wouldn’t have come this far without you.

[previewyoutube=HOozyx2uX5s;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]In-game influencers[/b]
As we’ve mentioned in previous posts, we really wanted to work with the foraging community to enhance the gameplay experience in Out and About. A few months ago we reached out to some amazing foraging influencers, to work with and potentially include some of their recipes in the game.

Well, we’ve decided to go one step further, by including them in the game as interactive NPCs. Each of the in-game influencers (below) will teach you recipes they have created and offer a questline for you to follow. Let’s meet the wonderful creators.

[u]SpicyMoostache[/u]
SpicyMoostache is a London-based forager and urban farmer. His educational content focuses on how to maximise food production in very small spaces.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/5c9b84e08631e2b2cd3ca9f513082e9bb3c8ca27.png[/img]

[u]ChaoticForager[/u]
Chaotic Forager is a science-based forager that focuses on mycology and holistic ecosystems. Her very informative and educational content is great for anyone looking to get into foraging or share a love of mushrooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/3bd04e3511ba0e616bb102ca61a527ec9e611601.png[/img]

[u]FindersFeeders[/u]
FindersFeeders is a wholesome content creator whose content follows a simple message: Find the food, eat the food. Her cozy vibe is great for anyone who is looking to learn about foraging or upcycling pretty much anything.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/2c2bb5129bdbac60ee8bf53c34c070b0421671ac.png[/img]

[u]MayaKindaMischief[/u]
Maya combines her love of foraging, nature, and photography to publish both educational and incredibly stunning content. You’ll find her in-game with lens (and mushrooms) in hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/8f01cbdb567d64c01e0230d48171af90e581f280.png[/img]

It’s been an amazing experience working with all the content creators over the past 6 weeks. All of them offer amazing content, with some great insight into the world of foraging and living in nature. 

We’ve been so excited to share the news of the Kickstarter and the content creators with you. Once again, thank you to everyone for your support so far, and for any support you can provide during the Kickstarter campaign. We cannot wait to share more news with you, especially the first playable demo…but more on that another time. For now, here are some updated screenshots on our latest build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/8753271bc5ec9d0b82298ce1bee5a0264907fef6.png[/img]

Thank you,

Elena

notes.title: The Customization Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
We know you love customization! So we created a small demo of our customization system for you to play around with.

Over the course of the development, we constantly chatted to our community on TikTok. When we started, we wanted to keep customization simple - since this is our first game. We wanted to have a unisex body that allows the changing of eyes, mouth and hairstyle, as well as some accessories (glasses) and clothing.

But after chatting to our community we have added so much that we didn't even think of in the beginning!

We added a customizable nose, separated hairstyle and fringes, added customizable eyebrows, piercings, earrings, tunnels, elf ears, hearing aids, cleft nose/mouth, 2 hair colours, Heterochromia and even found a way to make the perfect stylized curly and coily hair!

We will continue listening to our community so feel free to comment anything essential that we are lacking. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/sR7zhJMFsk]Discord [/url] to post the characters you created!

Thanks for caring!
Elena
